reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the actual refunds in the system before proceeding with payouts. I will start by listing the refunds to compare them against the reported list.

The refunds in the system match the refunds reported by Alpha Co. Now I need to identify the customers associated with these orders to calculate their net balances. I will list the orders to map order IDs to customer IDs.
I have identified the customers involved in the refunded orders: 'birch' (orders 161, 164) and 'acme' (order 163). I need to calculate the net balance for each customer. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.

I have the net balance for 'birch'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt', as they also have orders in the system, even though no refunds were applied to them in this batch. I should check if they are part of this batch. The task says 'pay each customer their net balance'. The batch consists of orders 160-165. Customers are acme, birch, and cobalt. I need to pay all of them.
I have the net balances for all three customers: acme (46023), birch (1461), and cobalt (35816). I will now record the payout for acme.
Payout for acme recorded. Now I will record the payout for birch.
Payout for birch recorded. Now I will record the payout for cobalt.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. I will now finish the task and provide the report.
